headings.usage: Use Cormorant Garamond for all H1, H2, H3. Apply tracking-tight. Combine with Noto Serif JP for occasional Japanese character accents (e.g. 日本語).

body.usage: Use for body text, UI elements, labels, and technical copy (like JLPT levels).

primary.name: Kyoto Deep Red
primary.usage: Dominant brand color. Use for full-bleed hero sections, footers, and active buttons. Never make the entire page red; alternate with cream sections.

secondary.name: Washi Cream
secondary.usage: Main background for content heavy sections.

accent.name: Warm Gold
accent.usage: Use sparingly for subtle highlights, thin dividers, or primary buttons on red backgrounds.

visual_enhancers.japanese_minimalism: Incorporate active negative space (Ma). Use 1px borders (border-[#B3121B]/20 or border-stone-200) for dividing lines. Do not use heavy drop shadows.
visual_enhancers.motifs: Implement subtle CSS-based background patterns (like Seigaiha waves) at 3-5% opacity in hero or transition bands. Never loud.
visual_enhancers.section_blocking: Alternate between full 'Kyoto Deep Red' sections (light text) and 'Washi Cream' sections (dark text) so the site breathes.
visual_enhancers.card_styles: Generous inner padding (p-8 or p-12), cream backgrounds, thin border, hover lift (-translate-y-2) with soft shadow.

components.name: Sticky Header
components.rules: Fixed top. On scroll, apply backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#F9F6F0]/80 and condense padding (py-4 to py-2). Include logo, 5 navigation links, and CTA. DO NOT use transparent background.

components.name: Trust Strip Counters
components.rules: Use framer-motion and react-countup for '5+ Years', '50+ Students', 'N3 to N1'. Display in a horizontal flex/grid layout.

components.name: Course Level Cards
components.rules: Bento style cards for N5 through N1. Include duration, hours/week, capabilities, and an '[ENQUIRE]' button placeholder.

components.name: Admission Stepper
components.rules: Vertical timeline component for Study in Japan page. Left border line with nodes for Counselling -> Language -> Visa -> Arrival.

components.name: Certificate Lightbox Gallery
components.rules: Grid of placeholders. Click to expand (lightbox) using framer-motion layoutId or simple dialog. Include student name, level, year.

components.name: Contact Form
components.rules: Use frontend validation with Zod. Show clear success state (e.g., replacing form with a 'Thank you' message) upon submission. Style inputs minimally (border-b).

grids.bento: Use CSS Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12) with asymmetrical spans (e.g., col-span-8, col-span-4) for the 'Why RSP in Japan' section.
grids.gallery: Auto-fit or auto-fill grids (grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3) for photos and certificates.

layouts.spacing: Generous margins and padding. Use py-24 or py-32 for standard section vertical padding. Use gap-8 or gap-12 for grids.

motion.scroll: Use Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling.
motion.reveals: Framer Motion 'whileInView' fade-up (opacity 0 to 1, y: 20 to 0) for section entry.
motion.hover: Cards should have 'transition-all duration-300 hover:-translate-y-2 hover:shadow-xl'. Buttons should have a slight scale.

accessibility.contrast: Red (#B3121B) with Cream (#F9F6F0) text passes WCAG. Ensure form inputs have clear focus rings.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs, lightbox triggers) MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute.
accessibility.aria: Use semantic tags (<section>, <article>, <nav>) and provide aria-labels for image placeholders.

media.placeholders: Image slots must use styled divs (e.g., bg-stone-200, border-dashed, border-stone-300) containing centered text clearly naming the placeholder (e.g., '[PLACEHOLDER: Student N1 Certificate]').
media.treatment: Images should have subtle rounded corners (rounded-lg) unless full-bleed. Do not use heavy borders on photos.

3d_libraries.recommendation: Not strictly required for this elegant 2D Japanese minimalist aesthetic. Focus on high-quality Framer Motion transitions instead.

hero_scenery.description: Kyoto traditional street with wooden houses. Use as the Hero background with a dark/red overlay.

instructions_to_main_agent.tech_stack: React (JS, NOT TSX), Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, React Router DOM, Lucide React.
instructions_to_main_agent.routing: Set up 5 distinct routes/pages: Home, About, Courses, Study in Japan, Success Stories. Use a shared Layout component with Header and Footer.

pages_breakdown.Home: Full-screen Red hero (logo/wordmark, headlines, buttons). Trust strip (animated counters). 'Why RSP' 3-4 bento cards. 'Life in Japan' image grid (use fetched images + placeholders). Success teaser. CTA band.
pages_breakdown.About: Two halves: 1. Founder bio (portrait placeholder, story, LinkedIn block, qualification cert placeholder). 2. Company history (Timeline 2020->Today) and Mission/Values cards.
pages_breakdown.Courses: N5 to N1 cards (duration, hours, capabilities, enquire). Batch formats info. JLPT mock-test info. Pathway diagram (Learn -> N3 -> Yokohama -> Study -> N2/N1 -> Job).
pages_breakdown.StudyInJapan: Yokohama language school overview. Vertical admission stepper. Living in Japan info. Placement info. Student photos gallery placeholders.
pages_breakdown.SuccessStories: Certificates responsive grid (placeholders with lightbox zoom). Testimonial cards. Contact form (Name, Phone, Email, Level, Batch, Message) with success state. Footer.

instructions_to_main_agent.implementation_notes: Use .js extensions. Ensure smooth scroll is globally applied. Do not invent details beyond the copy provided, but expand the mood creatively as instructed.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts; prioritize left-alignment for copy and asymmetrical grids for visuals.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Never apply universal transitions (transition: all). Target specific properties.
Add hover micro-interactions to all clickable elements.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid.
Do not use generic AI emojis.
For the red brand sections, use text-cream. Do not let text become unreadable.
Placeholders MUST be explicitly labeled, styled blocks, not empty spaces or broken image links.
